title: Three-service set badge
purpose: Shared set icon for the vending machine, car wash, and auto service cards.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the small circular badge placed immediately before a card title.
integration_context.background: Native RGBA transparency outside the circular badge.
integration_context.output_preference: RGBA PNG with alpha=0 outside the badge and clean antialiased edges

pictogram.description: Exactly one chunky combination wrench, diagonally oriented from lower-left to upper-right, with an open crescent jaw and one round box-end hole.
pictogram.line_rule: one unified solid white tool silhouette

visual_style.core: Flat two-color Machi Koro category badge.
visual_style.colors: graphite circle plus pure white pictogram
visual_style.small_size_priority: the single wrench remains readable beside a card title

uniqueness_constraints: Do not resemble the existing car, house, gear, factory, shop stall, truck, resources, tower, microphone, glass-and-fork, or shawarma icons.
Use exactly one object and no surrounding symbols.
anti_patterns: no additional tools, drops, machines, cars, hands, or other objects
no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, prices, or pseudo-writing
no realistic rendering, gradients, highlights, bevels, texture, or shadows
no opaque background or transparency holes inside the badge
final_prompt_summary: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: shared set badge for three Machi Koro-style cards. Create one solid graphite circle (#30343A) with transparent exterior. Inside it place exactly one bold white combination wrench, diagonally oriented from lower-left to upper-right, with an open crescent jaw and a round box-end hole. Flat two-color vector-style icon. No additional objects, text, logos, numbers, shading, texture, border, or background.
